body:
## APS Items — 20+ Powerful Custom Items for Cobblemon!
APS Items is a utility and held-item mod built for the APS Cobblemon modpack, adding over 20 custom items that enhance Pokémon battles, provide unique trainer tools, and introduce exclusive held items with real in-battle effects.

# ⚔️ Held Items — Battle Effects
Equip your Pokémon with these custom held items to gain a competitive edge. Each triggers a unique effect when activated in battle:

Brass Knuckles — Boosts the holder's Attack stat
Beam Visor — Boosts the holder's Special Attack stat
Swift Scarf — Boosts the holder's Speed stat
Critical Katana — Primes the holder's moves to land critical hits
Ditto Helmet — Copies the opposing Pokémon's stat boosts
Duper's Body Pillow — Automatically sets up a Substitute for the holder
Rubber Suit — Forces out the attacker when hit
Totem Tiki — A mysterious totem with unique battle properties


# 🔧 Pokebuilder Tools
Modify your Pokémon's stats and attributes with these tiered builder items:

Pokebuilder — Standard Pokémon editing tool
Damaged Pokebuilder — A worn-down version with limited functionality
Master Pokebuilder — Enhanced editing with greater power
Admin Pokebuilder — Staff-tier tool with full capabilities


# ✨ Modifiers
Reshape and re-roll your Pokémon's appearance with dedicated modifier items:

Shiny Powder — Applies a shiny transformation to a Pokémon
Legendary Shiny Powder — Shiny modifier for legendary Pokémon
Proportionator — Adjusts the size/scale of a Pokémon
Legendary Proportionator — Scale modifier for legendary Pokémon


# 🎒 Trainer Utility Items
Tools to help trainers manage, track, and grow their teams:

Exp. All — Distributes experience across the whole party
Competitive Clipboard — Exports your party data for competitive use
VS Recorder — Records and stores battle replays
Pokegun — A unique capture or utility tool


# 🌟 Cosmetic & Special Items

Minior Staff — A staff themed after the meteor Pokémon Minior, which also adds a custom Minior entity with full model, animations, and texture variants (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet, and Shiny)
